text: ぶきみな　とおぼえを　きいた　ポケモンは　ふるえ　いちもくさんに　じぶんの　すに　もどる。

structure.jp: ぶきみな　とおぼえを　きいた　ポケモンは
structure.en: Pokémon that have heard its eerie howl

structure.jp: いちもくさんに　じぶんの　すに　もどる。
structure.en: rush straight back to their own nests

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぶきみな　とおぼえを　きいた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, put before a noun, describes that noun. ぶきみな とおぼえを きいた ポケモン = 'Pokémon that heard the eerie howl'.

patterns.name: 〜ます形 (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut down to the part before ます joins on to the next action like 'and'; it is the written-style twin of the て-form. ふるえ = 'they tremble, and'.
